root_cause.text: In `calipso_skbuff_setattr()`, the code unconditionally adds `len_delta` (which can be negative when the new CALIPSO header is smaller than the existing header) to `skb_headroom(skb)` when calling `skb_cow()`, causing an integer underflow that results in a negative `nhead` value passed to `pskb_expand_head()`, triggering a `BUG_ON(nhead < 0)`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that the bug occurs when `skb_cow()` receives a headroom value > INT_MAX (because `skb_headroom(skb) + len_delta` becomes negative due to integer casting). The patch changes `len_delta` to be used only when positive: `skb_headroom(skb) + (len_delta > 0 ? len_delta : 0)`.
